The '''18th Critics' Choice Awards''' were presented on January 10, 2013 at the Barker Hangar at the [[Santa Monica Airport]], honoring the finest achievements of [[2012 in film|2012 filmmaking]].<ref>{{cite magazine |url=https://ew.com/article/2013/01/10/critics-choice-awards-winners/ |title=Critics' Choice Awards: 'Argo', 'Silver Linings Playbook' big winners |last=Vary |first=Adam B. |date=January 10, 2013 |magazine=[[Entertainment Weekly]] |access-date=January 10, 2013}}</ref> The ceremony was broadcast on [[The CW]] and hosted by [[Sam Rubin]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2013/01/sam-rubin-critics-choice-movie-awards-host-cw-400197/ |title=Sam Rubin to Host Critics' Choice Movie Awards |author=The Deadline Team |date=January 9, 2013 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=January 9, 2013}}</ref> The nominees were announced on December 11, 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.indiewire.com/awards/industry/basically-every-movie-nominated-in-bfca-critics-choice-awards-lineup-lincoln-leads-field-103060/ |title=Basically Every Movie Nominated in BFCA Critics' Choice Awards Lineup; 'Lincoln' Leads Field |last=Lyttelton |first=Oliver |date=December 11, 2012 |publisher=[[IndieWire]] |access-date=December 11, 2012 |archive-date=June 18, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230618222202/https://www.indiewire.com/awards/industry/basically-every-movie-nominated-in-bfca-critics-choice-awards-lineup-lincoln-leads-field-103060/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
